The Raw message headers window with a Copy headers button and the original header lines of the message.

entries.alt: The Filters panel under the search box: the buttons From, To, Subject, Body, Date and Folder, the checkboxes Has attachment, Unread, Flagged, Marked for follow-up, Finished, Mentions me and Include Trash, and the Add filter button.
The Filters panel after choosing From: a field for the sender, and the buttons Exclude matches, Apply and Cancel.
The Filters panel after choosing Date, with fields for After and Before.
The Filters panel after choosing Folder, with the choices All folders and Current folder (Inbox).
The mailbox with two messages selected: check marks on their rows, the floating selection bar at the bottom of the list, and in the reading area the panel 2 conversations selected.
The selection bar with markers on the count, Select all, Archive, Delete, More selection actions and Clear selection.
The More selection actions menu: Move to folder, Mark read, Flag, Mark as spam, Labels, Forward selected messages as attachments, Download selected messages as mbox and Download attachments as ZIP.
The panel in the reading area for two selected conversations: the buttons Select all in Inbox, Delete, Flag, Mark unread, Mark read, a Move to folder list, Properties and Cancel.
The folder list: Inbox, Drafts, Sent, Archive, Spam and Trash, then the group User folders with Projects and Receipts, each with unread and total counts.

The Create folder window with the name Clients typed, the Parent folder list set to Top level, and the buttons Cancel and Create folder.
The Label menu opened from a message row, listing the labels Work, Personal, Important, Later and Receipts, each with its colour and icon.

The Attachments screen: the filter form on top and a table of four files with their type, size, sender, subject and date.
The attachment filters with More filters open: sender, message subject, folder, received date, file size, file name and file extensions.
The table of attachments with sortable column headings File, Type, Size, Sender, Subject and Received, and one row per file.
A PDF opened in its own tab: the file name, a Download button and an information button at the top right, and the PDF viewer with its toolbar.
The Templates screen with the Shared list holding Office hours and the Personal list holding Chase a print proof and Quick thanks.

The context menu of a message row with the entry Copy or move to another account marked.

Settings open on Linked mailboxes: the list of linked mailboxes, which is empty, and the Link a mailbox button.
The Link a mailbox form with the fields Username or email address, Password and Display name (optional), and the buttons Verify and link and Cancel.
